ns0:entry.ns0:title: Seasonally adjusted government deficit at 3.3% of GDP in the euro area
ns0:entry.ns0:summary: In the second quarter of 2026, the seasonally adjusted general government deficit to GDP ratio stood at 3.3% in the euro area (EA21) and at 3.5% in the EU. ns0:entry.ns0:title: Government debt at 88.8% of GDP in euro area
ns0:entry.ns0:summary: At the end of the second quarter of 2026, the general government gross debt to GDP ratio in the euro area (EA21) stood at 88.8%, an increase compared with 88.4% at the end of the first quarter of 2026. In the EU, the ratio also increased from 82.5% to 82.9%.
